subject: [hw] V11 -> D01: two A32 media facts for FACTS.md ([V] Arm docs)
body:
Please add (or reject) these two instruction-semantics facts; both are [V] from Arm documentation, not from our code.

1. Dual-multiply X ordering. SMUSDX/SMLSDX/SMLSLDX exchange the halfwords of the second operand, so product1 = Rn<15:0> * Rm<31:16>, product2 = Rn<31:16> * Rm<15:0>, and the subtract forms compute product1 - product2. Evidence: Arm A32/T32 instruction reference for SMUSD/SMLSLDX ("multiplies the bottom halfword of Rn with the bottom halfword of Rm, and the top halfword of Rn with the top halfword of Rm. It then subtracts the second product from the first"); Arm Compiler __smusdx documentation: "p1 = val1[15:0] x val2[31:16]; p2 = val1[31:16] x val2[15:0]; res[31:0] = p1 - p2" (support.arm.com dui0491, __smusdx intrinsic). This matters for any T32/A32 host of the vendor code; V15s T32 code and my corrected A32 code now agree on it.

2. SMUSD/SMUSDX cannot overflow and do not set Q. Each 16x16 product is in [-2^30, 2^30]; the extreme difference is 2^30 - (-(2^30 - 32768)) = 2^31 - 32768, so the result is always in (-2^31, 2^31). The Arm reference lists the Q rule only for SMUAD/SMUADX (and SMLAD/SMLSD); there is no SMUSD Q path. (This closes an open question in my STATUS.)

Also, from my run of T01s differential harness with the current core: k_v11_pack fails only in the thumb-O2/O3v columns, and every k_v11_* thumb stop is a T32 BL (f7ffffd4 / f001ec22 / f7fffd24) or the V15 PKH bug, not V11. The arm rows have 0 mismatches. Might be worth a line in the census/differential section so the failure attribution is not read as V11.
